metadata.title: Learnigo - Science / Speak
metadata.subject: Science
metadata.generated_for: Children with dyslexia and other learning differences, approx. ages 5-10
design_principles: Every question is scored by speech recognition against expected_keywords, not a single fixed transcript, so natural phrasing is accepted.
The module climbs from simple echo and naming to talking through a full scientific investigation aloud, the deepest test of understanding.
speech_scoring.sample_answer shows one good answer for engineering/QA reference; expected_keywords define what actually triggers credit.
Three difficulty bands rotate inside every type: easy for fluency, medium for the learning edge, happy for pure joy.
This module has no reading or writing load at all, so it can reveal a child's true scientific reasoning independent of literacy skill.
Feedback praises the process, never the child's intelligence.
Question-generation and full-investigation items (13, 15) are scored for genuine scientific thinking shown, not a single correct string.
Safety, honesty and help-seeking items carry a mastery_weight above 1.0 so they surface in reports even when accuracy overall is high.

tts_guidance.note: Read audio_text exactly as written when read-aloud support is used. For sequence and multi-select items, pause 500ms between listed items.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reproducing a heard science word accurately
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline articulation check for science vocabulary specifically, isolating pronunciation from meaning.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: retrieving a spoken science label for a known concept
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Pure word-finding with no reading or listening involved - isolates science vocabulary retrieval itself.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a known animal sound in response to a named animal
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Playful oral science content connecting vocabulary directly to auditory-motor production.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: decoding and speaking a printed science word
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Direct fluency check for subject-specific vocabulary, which often uses less familiar spelling patterns.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reading a connected science sentence aloud with reasonable flow
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Shows whether single-word science vocabulary decoding holds together across a full sentence.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: retrieving and speaking a known science fact without prompting for a specific one
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Open factual recall shows what a child genuinely knows and can express, not just what they can select.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: naming a category aloud and justifying the classification
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Combines classification with spoken reasoning - the 'why' matters as much as the category itself.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: generating original spoken description of a scene using specific science vocabulary
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether science vocabulary transfers into natural, unprompted spoken description.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding two items in mind and speaking the comparison result
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Oral version of comparative science reasoning, testing judgement without any visual symbols to lean on.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a spoken retelling with correct process order
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The oral equivalent of written sequencing tasks, without any reading or writing load at all.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: verbalising both an effect and the underlying reason for it
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A step beyond simple prediction - explaining the mechanism, not just the outcome.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a genuine, answerable question about a science topic
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Question-generation is a core scientific skill, distinct from answering - the seed of all real investigation.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: describing a method for testing a stated question
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether the idea of a fair test can be applied and spoken, not just recognised in someone else's description.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing an original, extended spoken account of a full scientific inquiry
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - a full spoken investigation, the destination every other Speak type builds toward.

difficulty_band.easy: Consolidation. Child should succeed ~90% of the time. Builds fluency and confidence.
difficulty_band.medium: Learning edge. Target ~65-75% success. This is where growth data lives.
difficulty_band.happy: Pure joy question. Near-certain success, silly or warm content, low mastery weight. Placed to reset mood after effort and to keep the session feeling like play.

reporting_recipes.skill_profile: Group accuracy by academic.skill and cognition.process to find the child's cognitive shape (e.g. strong discriminate / weak sequence).
reporting_recipes.life_skill_radar: Group accuracy by life_skill.domain across all subjects to build a 14-spoke life-skill radar chart per child.
reporting_recipes.dyslexia_error_map: Count wrong answers by distractor_insight value, not just by question. The distractor tells you WHY, so one wrong tap becomes a diagnosis.
reporting_recipes.attention_curve: Plot time_to_first_touch and accuracy against telemetry.session_position to find the child's real attention span, then cap session length there.
reporting_recipes.working_memory_ceiling: Accuracy vs cognition.working_memory_load. The load level where accuracy drops below 60% is the child's current WM ceiling - never exceed it during teaching.
reporting_recipes.confidence_calibration: Compare the wellbeing.confidence_prompt answer with actual correctness. Confident+wrong = misconception to correct. Unsure+right = needs reassurance, not more teaching.
reporting_recipes.impulsivity_index: Wrong answers where time_to_first_touch < 25% of expected_response_time_ms. High index means teach 'wait and think', not more content.
reporting_recipes.persistence_index: Retry rate and abandon rate on medium-band items. Falling persistence over weeks is an early wellbeing flag.
reporting_recipes.mood_trend: Track emotion_checkin responses over sessions. Two sad check-ins in a row should lower difficulty automatically for the next session.
reporting_recipes.personality_map: Aggregate personality_signal outcomes to describe tendencies (e.g. cautious, highly pro-social, low help-seeking) for the parent report.

wellbeing_rules: No question ever shows a countdown clock. Speed is rewarded, never punished.
Feedback praises the process ('you listened right to the end'), never the child's intelligence.
After two wrong answers the app shows how it works instead of asking again.
A happy-band question follows any run of three errors.
Every safety and help-seeking question points the child towards a trusted grown-up.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen. Say the science word back.
hints: Say exactly what you heard.
questions.worked_example: Listen once more, then copy exactly what you hear.

feedback.correct: Butterfly - said clearly. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Listen once more and copy the word exactly.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Noticing small creatures around you is where real curiosity starts.

analysis.primary_construct: reproducing a heard science word accurately
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline articulation check for science vocabulary specifically, isolating pronunciation from meaning.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Consistent substitution of one sound for another in a science word points to a specific articulation pattern worth noting.
analysis.parent_note: A simple echo check that science words are being produced clearly, not just heard correctly.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Model the science word slowly, exaggerating any tricky sound, then ask for an echo.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say a fact you know about this.
questions.prompt: bees
hints: Think of just one thing you already know.
questions.worked_example: Think of just one thing you already know, then say it out loud.

feedback.correct: A real fact, in your own words. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Think of just one thing you know about bees, then say it.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: spontaneous factual recall and speech production

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Bees look busy because they are - they help our food grow.

analysis.primary_construct: retrieving and speaking a known science fact without prompting for a specific one
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Open factual recall shows what a child genuinely knows and can express, not just what they can select.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A long pause before any fact at all, for a familiar topic, may flag retrieval speed rather than a knowledge gap.
analysis.parent_note: Letting a child choose which fact to share shows real ownership of their science knowledge.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'tell me something you know about that' often, with genuine curiosity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Bees collect nectar from flowers and help make honey.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say a fact you know about this.
questions.prompt: butterflies
hints: Think of just one thing you already know.
questions.worked_example: Think of just one thing you already know, then say it out loud.

feedback.correct: A real fact, in your own words. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Think of just one thing you know about butterflies, then say it.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: spontaneous factual recall and speech production

life_skill.hidden_lesson: The cocoon stage hides one of nature's most amazing transformations.

analysis.primary_construct: retrieving and speaking a known science fact without prompting for a specific one
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Open factual recall shows what a child genuinely knows and can express, not just what they can select.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A long pause before any fact at all, for a familiar topic, may flag retrieval speed rather than a knowledge gap.
analysis.parent_note: Letting a child choose which fact to share shows real ownership of their science knowledge.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'tell me something you know about that' often, with genuine curiosity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Butterflies start as caterpillars and change inside a chrysalis.

questions.subject: Science

feedback.correct: A clear description using real science vocabulary. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Look carefully. What's happening, using a science word if you can?

academic.skill: oral descriptive language with science vocabulary

life_skill.hidden_lesson: All that eating stores up energy for the huge change ahead.

analysis.primary_construct: generating original spoken description of a scene using specific science vocabulary
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether science vocabulary transfers into natural, unprompted spoken description.

academic.skill: oral narrative sequencing of a science process

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: Two identical ice cubes - one in a warm room, one in the fridge.
hints: Which environment is warmer, and what does warmth do to ice?

feedback.correct: The warm room one melts faster - a well-reasoned, comparative prediction. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Think about which environment is warmer, and what that means for melting speed.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Comparing two setups with just one difference is the heart of a fair test.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The one in the warm room will melt faster, because warmth speeds up melting.

hints: Môi trường nào ấm hơn, và sự ấm làm gì với đá?

feedback.correct: Viên đá trong phòng ấm sẽ tan nhanh hơn - một dự đoán so sánh có lý do rõ ràng. 🧊

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Viên đá trong phòng ấm sẽ tan nhanh hơn, vì sự ấm làm tăng tốc độ tan chảy.

narration.text: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra. Hai viên đá giống nhau - một để trong phòng ấm, một để trong tủ lạnh.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: A caterpillar has eaten a huge amount of leaves for weeks.
hints: What is all that eating usually preparing a caterpillar for?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: It will build a chrysalis and become a butterfly - a well-reasoned prediction. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Think about what all that eating usually leads to, then say your prediction.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: All that eating stores up the energy needed for the huge change ahead.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: It will probably form a chrysalis soon and change into a butterfly.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Una oruga ha comido una enorme cantidad de hojas durante semanas.
hints: ¿Para qué suele prepararse una oruga con toda esa comida?

feedback.correct: Formará una crisálida y se convertirá en mariposa - una predicción bien razonada. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en a qué suele llevar toda esa comida, y luego di tu predicción.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Probablemente formará pronto una crisálida y se convertirá en mariposa.

narration.text: Di qué predices que va a pasar. Una oruga ha comido una enorme cantidad de hojas durante semanas.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.

narration.text: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer. Une chenille a mangé une énorme quantité de feuilles pendant des semaines.

narration.text: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer. Uma lagarta comeu uma quantidade enorme de folhas durante semanas.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.

narration.text: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird. Eine Raupe hat wochenlang eine riesige Menge an Blättern gefressen.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Een rups heeft wekenlang enorm veel bladeren gegeten.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 一只毛毛虫已经连续几个星期吃了大量的叶子。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.

narration.text: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요. 애벌레가 몇 주 동안 아주 많은 잎을 먹었습니다.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.

feedback.incorrect: 暖かさと時間が食べ物の安全性にどう関係するか考えて、予想を言おう。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: もう食べるのに安全ではないかもしれないよ、暖かさで細菌が増えるから。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.

hints: 따뜻함과 시간은 보통 음식의 안전에 무엇을 할까요?

feedback.correct: 더 이상 안전하지 않을 수도 있어요 - 잘 추론한, 안전과 관련된 예측이에요. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: 따뜻함과 시간이 음식 안전에 보통 무엇을 하는지 생각하고 예측을 말해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 따뜻함이 세균을 자라게 하기 때문에 더 이상 먹기에 안전하지 않을 수도 있어요.

narration.text: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요. 고기가 든 도시락을 더운 차 안에 하루 종일 둡니다.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.

feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan apa yang biasanya dilakukan kehangatan dan waktu terhadap keamanan makanan, lalu ucapkan prediksimu.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Makanannya mungkin sudah tidak aman untuk dimakan, karena kehangatan membuat bakteri tumbuh.

narration.text: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi. Sebuah kotak makan berisi daging ditinggalkan di dalam mobil yang panas sepanjang hari.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.

vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Nó có thể không còn an toàn nữa - một dự đoán có lý do rõ ràng, liên quan đến an toàn. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem sự ấm và thời gian thường ảnh hưởng gì đến độ an toàn của thực phẩm, rồi nói dự đoán của bạn.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Nó có thể không còn an toàn để ăn nữa, vì sự ấm khiến vi khuẩn phát triển.

narration.text: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra. Một hộp cơm có thịt bên trong bị để trong xe nóng cả ngày.
Think about meat in a lunchbox in a hot car. Say what will happen.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: A scientist adds special fertiliser to only one of two identical plants.
hints: What is fertiliser generally meant to help a plant do?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: The fertilised plant might grow better - a well-reasoned prediction. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Think about what fertiliser is generally meant to help a plant do, then say your prediction.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.primary: Predicting outcomes of a fair test aloud
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Changing only one thing at a time is exactly what makes a test's results trustworthy.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The fertilised plant might grow taller or healthier than the other one.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Un científico añade fertilizante especial solo a una de dos plantas idénticas.
hints: ¿Para qué sirve generalmente el fertilizante en una planta?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: La planta fertilizada podría crecer mejor - una predicción bien razonada. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en para qué sirve generalmente el fertilizante en una planta, y luego di tu predicción.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La planta fertilizada podría crecer más alta o más sana que la otra.

narration.text: Di qué predices que va a pasar. Un científico añade fertilizante especial solo a una de dos plantas idénticas.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Un scientifique ajoute un engrais spécial à une seule de deux plantes identiques.
hints: À quoi l'engrais aide-t-il généralement une plante ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. Dis ta meilleure hypothèse, et pourquoi.

feedback.correct: La plante avec engrais pourrait mieux grandir - une prédiction bien raisonnée. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pense à ce que l'engrais aide généralement une plante à faire, puis dis ta prédiction.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La plante avec engrais pourrait devenir plus grande ou plus saine que l'autre.

narration.text: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer. Un scientifique ajoute un engrais spécial à une seule de deux plantes identiques.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.
pt.prompt: Um cientista adiciona um fertilizante especial em apenas uma de duas plantas idênticas.
hints: Para que o fertilizante geralmente ajuda uma planta?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. Diga seu melhor palpite, e por quê.

feedback.correct: A planta fertilizada pode crescer melhor - uma previsão bem fundamentada. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pense para que o fertilizante geralmente ajuda uma planta, depois diga sua previsão.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: A planta fertilizada pode crescer mais alta ou mais saudável do que a outra.

narration.text: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer. Um cientista adiciona um fertilizante especial em apenas uma de duas plantas idênticas.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.
it.prompt: Uno scienziato aggiunge del fertilizzante speciale solo a una delle due piante identiche.
hints: A cosa serve di solito il fertilizzante per aiutare una pianta?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: La pianta fertilizzata potrebbe crescere meglio - una previsione ben ragionata. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a cosa serve di solito il fertilizzante per aiutare una pianta, poi dì la tua previsione.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La pianta fertilizzata potrebbe crescere più alta o più sana dell'altra.

narration.text: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà. Uno scienziato aggiunge del fertilizzante speciale solo a una delle due piante identiche.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Ein Wissenschaftler gibt nur einer von zwei gleichen Pflanzen speziellen Dünger.
hints: Wobei soll Dünger einer Pflanze normalerweise helfen?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Sag deine beste Vermutung, und warum.

feedback.correct: Die gedüngte Pflanze könnte besser wachsen – eine gut begründete Vorhersage. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, wobei Dünger einer Pflanze normalerweise helfen soll, und sag dann deine Vorhersage.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Die gedüngte Pflanze könnte größer oder gesünder wachsen als die andere.

narration.text: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird. Ein Wissenschaftler gibt nur einer von zwei gleichen Pflanzen speziellen Dünger.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Een wetenschapper geeft speciale mest aan maar één van twee identieke planten.
hints: Waarbij helpt mest een plant meestal?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: De bemeste plant groeit mogelijk beter - een goed beredeneerde voorspelling. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan waarbij mest een plant meestal helpt, en zeg dan je voorspelling.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: De bemeste plant groeit mogelijk hoger of gezonder dan de andere.

narration.text: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren. Een wetenschapper geeft speciale mest aan maar één van twee identieke planten.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Учёный добавляет специальное удобрение только одному из двух одинаковых растений.
hints: В чём обычно удобрение помогает растению?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Удобренное растение может расти лучше — хорошо обоснованное предсказание. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, в чём обычно удобрение помогает растению, затем скажи своё предсказание.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Удобренное растение может вырасти выше или здоровее, чем другое.

narration.text: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт. Учёный добавляет специальное удобрение только одному из двух одинаковых растений.

tr.prompt: Bir bilim insanı, iki aynı bitkiden sadece birine özel gübre ekliyor.
hints: Gübre genellikle bir bitkinin ne yapmasına yardımcı olmak içindir?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Gübrelenen bitki daha iyi büyüyebilir - iyi akıl yürütülmüş bir tahmin. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Gübrenin genellikle bir bitkinin ne yapmasına yardımcı olmak için olduğunu düşün, sonra tahminini söyle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Gübrelenen bitki diğerinden daha uzun veya daha sağlıklı büyüyebilir.

narration.text: Ne olacağını tahmin ettiğini söyle. Bir bilim insanı, iki aynı bitkiden sadece birine özel gübre ekliyor.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 一位科学家只给两株完全一样的植物中的一株施加了特殊肥料。
hints: 肥料通常是用来帮助植物做什么的?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 施肥的那株植物可能会长得更好——这是一个推理合理的预测。🌿
feedback.incorrect: 想一想肥料通常是用来帮助植物做什么的,然后说出你的预测。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 施肥的那株植物可能会比另一株长得更高或更健康。

narration.text: 说一说你预测会发生什么。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。

feedback.correct: 肥料をあげた植物の方が、よく育つかもしれないよ。よく考えられた予想だね。🌿
feedback.incorrect: 肥料がふつう植物の何を助けるか考えて、予想を言おう。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 肥料をあげた植物の方が、もう片方より背が高くなるか、健康に育つかもしれないよ。

narration.text: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。科学者が、同じ植物2つのうち1つだけに特別な肥料をあげる。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 비료를 준 식물이 더 잘 자랄 수도 있어요 - 잘 추론한 예측이에요. 🌿

feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 비료를 준 식물이 다른 식물보다 더 크거나 건강하게 자랄 수도 있어요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tumbuhan yang dipupuk mungkin akan tumbuh lebih tinggi atau lebih sehat daripada yang lainnya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Cây được bón phân có thể sẽ cao hơn hoặc khỏe hơn cây còn lại.

narration.text: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: Scientists notice ice at the poles getting thinner every year, alongside rising ocean temperatures.
hints: If a trend keeps happening, what does that usually suggest about the future?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: More melting and rising sea levels - a genuinely careful, advanced prediction. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Think about what continuing an existing trend usually suggests for the future.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Scientists use exactly this kind of trend-based reasoning to study our changing climate.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: More ice might melt and sea levels could rise if this trend continues.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Los científicos notan que el hielo en los polos se vuelve más delgado cada año, junto con el aumento de la temperatura del océano.
hints: Si una tendencia sigue pasando, ¿qué suele eso sugerir sobre el futuro?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: Más deshielo y subida del nivel del mar - una predicción avanzada, realmente cuidadosa. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué suele sugerir sobre el futuro que una tendencia siga igual.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Más hielo podría derretirse y el nivel del mar podría subir si esta tendencia continúa.

narration.text: Di qué predices que va a pasar.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Les scientifiques remarquent que la glace aux pôles devient plus fine chaque année, en même temps que les températures des océans augmentent.
hints: Si une tendance continue, qu'est-ce que ça suggère généralement pour l'avenir ?

feedback.correct: Plus de fonte et une montée du niveau des mers - une prédiction vraiment réfléchie et avancée. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pense à ce que la continuation d'une tendance existante suggère généralement pour l'avenir.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Plus de glace pourrait fondre et le niveau des mers pourrait monter si cette tendance continue.

narration.text: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.

feedback.incorrect: Pense no que continuar uma tendência existente geralmente sugere para o futuro.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Mais gelo pode derreter e o nível do mar pode subir se essa tendência continuar.

narration.text: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.

hints: Se una tendenza continua a verificarsi, cosa suggerisce di solito per il futuro?

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Più ghiaccio potrebbe sciogliersi e il livello del mare potrebbe aumentare se questa tendenza continua.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Introduced species without natural predators can sometimes become a real problem for an ecosystem.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: It could grow very quickly and spread widely without anything to control it.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: Two identical plants - one watered daily, one watered only once a week.
hints: Which plant is getting closer to what it needs to thrive?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: The daily-watered plant is likely healthier - a well-reasoned, comparative prediction. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Think about which watering schedule is closer to what a plant actually needs.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: A fair test like this, changing only watering, gives a genuinely trustworthy result.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The plant watered daily may grow bigger, but some plants are harmed by too much water.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Dos plantas idénticas - una se riega todos los días, la otra solo una vez a la semana.
hints: ¿Qué planta se acerca más a lo que necesita para prosperar?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: La planta regada a diario probablemente esté más sana - una predicción comparativa bien razonada. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué horario de riego se acerca más a lo que una planta realmente necesita.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La planta regada a diario puede crecer más, pero a algunas plantas les hace daño demasiada agua.

narration.text: Di qué predices que va a pasar.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Deux plantes identiques - l'une arrosée chaque jour, l'autre arrosée seulement une fois par semaine.
hints: Laquelle des deux plantes se rapproche le plus de ce dont elle a besoin pour bien se développer ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. Dis ta meilleure hypothèse, et pourquoi.

feedback.correct: La plante arrosée chaque jour est probablement plus saine - une prédiction comparative bien raisonnée. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pense à quel rythme d'arrosage se rapproche le plus de ce dont une plante a vraiment besoin.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La plante arrosée chaque jour peut devenir plus grande, mais trop d'eau abîme certaines plantes.

narration.text: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer. Deux plantes identiques - l'une arrosée chaque jour, l'autre arrosée seulement une fois par semaine.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.
pt.prompt: Duas plantas idênticas - uma regada todo dia, outra regada só uma vez por semana.
hints: Qual planta está chegando mais perto do que precisa para prosperar?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. Diga seu melhor palpite, e por quê.

feedback.correct: A planta regada todo dia provavelmente está mais saudável - uma previsão comparativa bem fundamentada. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual rotina de rega está mais perto do que uma planta realmente precisa.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: A planta regada todo dia pode crescer mais, mas água demais faz mal a algumas plantas.

narration.text: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer. Duas plantas idênticas - uma regada todo dia, outra regada só uma vez por semana.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.
it.prompt: Due piante identiche - una bagnata ogni giorno, una bagnata solo una volta a settimana.
hints: Quale pianta si avvicina di più a quello di cui ha bisogno per crescere bene?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: La pianta bagnata ogni giorno è probabilmente più sana - una previsione ben ragionata e comparativa. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale programma di irrigazione si avvicina di più a quello di cui una pianta ha davvero bisogno.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La pianta bagnata ogni giorno può crescere di più, ma troppa acqua danneggia alcune piante.

narration.text: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà. Due piante identiche - una bagnata ogni giorno, una bagnata solo una volta a settimana.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Zwei gleiche Pflanzen – eine wird täglich gegossen, die andere nur einmal pro Woche.
hints: Welche Pflanze bekommt eher das, was sie zum Gedeihen braucht?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Sag deine beste Vermutung, und warum.

feedback.correct: Die täglich gegossene Pflanze ist wahrscheinlich gesünder – eine gut begründete, vergleichende Vorhersage. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, welcher Gießplan eher dem entspricht, was eine Pflanze tatsächlich braucht.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Die täglich gegossene Pflanze kann größer werden, aber manchen Pflanzen schadet zu viel Wasser.

narration.text: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird. Zwei gleiche Pflanzen – eine wird täglich gegossen, die andere nur einmal pro Woche.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Twee identieke planten - één elke dag water gegeven, één maar één keer per week.
hints: Welke plant komt dichter bij wat hij nodig heeft om te gedijen?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: De dagelijks begoten plant is waarschijnlijk gezonder - een goed beredeneerde, vergelijkende voorspelling. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan welk bewateringsschema dichter bij komt wat een plant echt nodig heeft.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: De plant die elke dag water krijgt, kan groter worden, maar sommige planten krijgen schade door te veel water.

narration.text: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren. Twee identieke planten - één elke dag water gegeven, één maar één keer per week.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Два одинаковых растения — одно поливают каждый день, другое — только раз в неделю.
hints: Какое растение получает больше того, что нужно ему для процветания?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Растение, которое поливают каждый день, вероятно, здоровее — хорошо обоснованное, сравнительное предсказание. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, какой график полива ближе к тому, что растению действительно нужно.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Растение, которое поливают каждый день, может вырасти больше, но некоторым растениям слишком много воды вредит.

narration.text: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт. Два одинаковых растения — одно поливают каждый день, другое — только раз в неделю.

tr.prompt: İki aynı bitki - biri her gün, biri sadece haftada bir sulanıyor.
hints: Hangi bitki, gelişmek için ihtiyacı olana daha yakın?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Her gün sulanan bitki muhtemelen daha sağlıklı - iyi akıl yürütülmüş, karşılaştırmalı bir tahmin. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Hangi sulama programının bir bitkinin gerçekte ihtiyacına daha yakın olduğunu düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Her gün sulanan bitki daha büyük olabilir, ama bazı bitkilere çok fazla su zarar verir.

narration.text: Ne olacağını tahmin ettiğini söyle. İki aynı bitki - biri her gün, biri sadece haftada bir sulanıyor.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 两株完全一样的植物——一株每天浇水,一株只每周浇水一次。
hints: 哪一株植物更接近它茂盛生长所需要的条件?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 每天浇水的那株植物可能更健康——这是一个推理合理的比较性预测。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 想一想哪种浇水方式更接近植物真正需要的条件。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 每天浇水的植物可能长得更大,但有些植物会因为水太多而受伤害。

narration.text: 说一说你预测会发生什么。两株完全一样的植物——一株每天浇水,一株只每周浇水一次。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。
ja.prompt: 同じ植物2つ。1つは毎日水をやり、もう1つは週に1回だけ水をやる。
hints: どちらの植物が、元気に育つために必要なものに近づいている?
ja.worked_example: すでに知っていることを考えよう。一番良さそうな予想と、その理由を言おう。

feedback.correct: 毎日水をもらう植物の方が、たぶん健康だよ。よく考えられた、比べる予想だね。🌱
feedback.incorrect: どちらの水やりの方法が、植物に本当に必要なものに近いか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 毎日水をもらう植物の方が大きくなるかもしれないけど、水が多すぎるといたんでしまう植物もあるよ。

narration.text: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。同じ植物2つ。1つは毎日水をやり、もう1つは週に1回だけ水をやる。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.
ko.prompt: 똑같은 식물 두 개 - 하나는 매일 물을 주고, 하나는 일주일에 한 번만 물을 줍니다.
hints: 어느 식물이 잘 자라는 데 필요한 것에 더 가까울까요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해보세요. 가장 그럴듯한 추측과 그 이유를 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 매일 물을 준 식물이 더 건강할 가능성이 높아요 - 잘 추론한 비교 예측이에요. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: 어느 물주기 방식이 식물에게 실제로 필요한 것에 더 가까운지 생각해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 매일 물을 준 식물이 더 크게 자랄 수 있지만, 어떤 식물은 물이 너무 많으면 해를 입어요.

narration.text: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요. 똑같은 식물 두 개 - 하나는 매일 물을 주고, 하나는 일주일에 한 번만 물을 줍니다.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.
id.prompt: Dua tumbuhan yang identik - satu disiram setiap hari, satu hanya disiram sekali seminggu.
hints: Tumbuhan mana yang lebih mendekati apa yang dibutuhkannya untuk tumbuh subur?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Ucapkan tebakan terbaikmu, dan alasannya.

feedback.correct: Tumbuhan yang disiram setiap hari kemungkinan lebih sehat - prediksi perbandingan yang beralasan dengan baik. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan jadwal penyiraman mana yang lebih mendekati apa yang sebenarnya dibutuhkan tumbuhan.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tumbuhan yang disiram setiap hari mungkin tumbuh lebih besar, tetapi beberapa tumbuhan rusak karena terlalu banyak air.

narration.text: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi. Dua tumbuhan yang identik - satu disiram setiap hari, satu hanya disiram sekali seminggu.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
vi.prompt: Hai cây giống nhau - một được tưới nước mỗi ngày, một chỉ được tưới một lần mỗi tuần.
hints: Cây nào đang được đáp ứng gần hơn với điều nó cần để phát triển tốt?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Cây được tưới mỗi ngày có thể sẽ khỏe hơn - một dự đoán so sánh có lý do rõ ràng. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem lịch tưới nước nào gần hơn với điều cây thực sự cần.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Cây được tưới mỗi ngày có thể lớn hơn, nhưng một số loại cây bị hại vì quá nhiều nước.

narration.text: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
Read about the two plants and their water. Say what will happen.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain what would happen, and why.
questions.prompt: Why does ice melt in a warm room?
hints: Say what happens, then say why.
questions.worked_example: Say what happens first. Then add one because.

feedback.correct: A clear explanation with both the effect and the reason. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Say what happens to ice, then explain why it happens.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Melting doesn't make something disappear - it just changes its state.

analysis.primary_construct: verbalising both an effect and the underlying reason for it
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: A step beyond simple prediction - explaining the mechanism, not just the outcome.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Stating an effect correctly with no explanation of why shows the fact, not the mechanism, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just what, is where deeper science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why does that happen' after sharing any cause-and-effect fact.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Because warmth changes ice from solid back into liquid water.

es.instruction: Explica qué pasaría, y por qué.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué se derrite el hielo en una habitación cálida?
hints: Di qué pasa, y luego di por qué.
es.worked_example: Di primero qué pasa. Luego añade un porqué.

feedback.correct: Una explicación clara, con el efecto y la razón. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Di qué le pasa al hielo, y luego explica por qué pasa.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Porque el calor convierte el hielo, de sólido, otra vez en agua líquida.

narration.text: Explica qué pasaría, y por qué. ¿Por qué se derrite el hielo en una habitación cálida?

fr.instruction: Explique ce qui se passerait, et pourquoi.
fr.prompt: Pourquoi la glace fond-elle dans une pièce chaude ?
hints: Dis ce qui se passe, puis dis pourquoi.
fr.worked_example: Dis d'abord ce qui se passe. Puis ajoute un parce que.

feedback.correct: Une explication claire avec l'effet et la raison. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Dis ce qui arrive à la glace, puis explique pourquoi ça arrive.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Parce que la chaleur transforme la glace solide en eau liquide.

narration.text: Explique ce qui se passerait, et pourquoi. Pourquoi la glace fond-elle dans une pièce chaude?

pt.instruction: Explique o que aconteceria, e por quê.
pt.prompt: Por que o gelo derrete em uma sala quente?
hints: Diga o que acontece, depois diga por quê.
pt.worked_example: Diga primeiro o que acontece. Depois adicione um porque.

feedback.correct: Uma explicação clara, com o efeito e o motivo. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Diga o que acontece com o gelo, depois explique por quê.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Porque o calor transforma o gelo de sólido de volta em água líquida.

narration.text: Explique o que aconteceria, e por quê. Por que o gelo derrete em uma sala quente?

it.instruction: Spiega cosa accadrebbe, e perché.
it.prompt: Perché il ghiaccio si scioglie in una stanza calda?
hints: Dì cosa succede, poi dì perché.
it.worked_example: Dì prima cosa succede. Poi aggiungi un perché.

feedback.correct: Una spiegazione chiara con l'effetto e la ragione. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Dì cosa succede al ghiaccio, poi spiega perché succede.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Perché il calore trasforma il ghiaccio da solido di nuovo in acqua liquida.

narration.text: Spiega cosa accadrebbe, e perché. Perché il ghiaccio si scioglie in una stanza calda?

de.instruction: Erkläre, was passieren würde, und warum.
de.prompt: Warum schmilzt Eis in einem warmen Zimmer?
hints: Sag, was passiert, dann sag warum.
de.worked_example: Sag zuerst, was passiert. Füge dann ein Weil hinzu.

feedback.correct: Eine klare Erklärung mit sowohl der Wirkung als auch dem Grund. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Sag, was mit Eis passiert, dann erkläre warum es passiert.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Weil Wärme Eis von fest wieder in flüssiges Wasser verändert.

narration.text: Erkläre, was passieren würde, und warum. Warum schmilzt Eis in einem warmen Zimmer?

nl.instruction: Leg uit wat er zou gebeuren, en waarom.
nl.prompt: Waarom smelt ijs in een warme kamer?
hints: Zeg wat er gebeurt, en zeg dan waarom.
nl.worked_example: Zeg eerst wat er gebeurt. Voeg dan één omdat toe.

feedback.correct: Een duidelijke uitleg met zowel het effect als de reden. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Zeg wat er met ijs gebeurt, en leg dan uit waarom.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Omdat warmte ijs verandert van vast terug naar vloeibaar water.

narration.text: Leg uit wat er zou gebeuren, en waarom. Waarom smelt ijs in een warme kamer?

ru.instruction: Объясни, что произойдёт, и почему.
ru.prompt: Почему лёд тает в тёплой комнате?
hints: Скажи, что происходит, затем скажи почему.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи, что происходит. Потом добавь одно «потому что».

feedback.correct: Чёткое объяснение, включающее и следствие, и причину. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Скажи, что происходит со льдом, затем объясни, почему это происходит.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Потому что тепло превращает лёд из твёрдого состояния обратно в жидкую воду.

narration.text: Объясни, что произойдёт, и почему. Почему лёд тает в тёплой комнате?

tr.prompt: Buz sıcak bir odada neden erir?
hints: Ne olduğunu söyle, sonra nedenini söyle.
tr.worked_example: Önce ne olacağını söyle. Sonra bir 'çünkü' ekle.

feedback.correct: Hem etkiyi hem de nedeni içeren açık bir açıklama. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Buza ne olduğunu söyle, sonra neden olduğunu açıkla.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Çünkü sıcaklık buzu katıdan tekrar sıvı suya değiştirir.

narration.text: Ne olacağını ve nedenini açıkla. Buz sıcak bir odada neden erir?

zh.instruction: 解释会发生什么,以及为什么。
zh.prompt: 为什么冰在温暖的房间里会融化?
hints: 先说会发生什么,然后说为什么。
zh.worked_example: 先说出会发生什么,然后加上一个“因为”来说明原因。

feedback.correct: 一个清楚的解释,既说了结果,也说了原因。🧊
feedback.incorrect: 先说冰会发生什么,然后解释为什么会这样。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 因为温暖会把冰从固态变回液态的水。

narration.text: 解释会发生什么,以及为什么。为什么冰在温暖的房间里会融化?

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか、そしてその理由を説明しよう。
ja.prompt: なぜ氷は暖かい部屋で溶けるの?
hints: 何が起こるかを言って、それから理由を言おう。
ja.worked_example: まず何が起こるかを言おう。それから、理由を1つ付け加えよう。

feedback.correct: 起きることとその理由を、両方はっきり説明できたね。🧊
feedback.incorrect: 氷に何が起こるかを言って、それからなぜそれが起こるか説明しよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 暖かさが、氷という固体を、また液体の水に変えるから。

narration.text: 何が起こるか、そしてその理由を説明しよう。なぜ氷は暖かい部屋で溶けるの?

ko.instruction: 무슨 일이 일어날지, 그리고 왜 그런지 설명해보세요.
hints: 무슨 일이 일어나는지 말하고, 그다음 왜 그런지 말하세요.
ko.worked_example: 먼저 무슨 일이 일어나는지 말하세요. 그다음 이유를 하나 덧붙이세요.

ru.instruction: Объясни, что произойдёт, и почему.

id.instruction: Jelaskan apa yang akan terjadi, dan alasannya.

narration.text: Jelaskan apa yang akan terjadi, dan alasannya. Mengapa ulat perlu makan sangat banyak sebelum menjadi pupa?

vi.instruction: Giải thích điều gì sẽ xảy ra, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Một lời giải thích rõ ràng, có cả hành vi và lý do đằng sau nó. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Nói điều sâu bướm đang chuẩn bị cho, rồi giải thích vì sao nó cần năng lượng đó.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Nó cần tích trữ đủ năng lượng cho sự thay đổi lớn diễn ra bên trong con nhộng.

narration.text: Giải thích điều gì sẽ xảy ra, và vì sao. Vì sao sâu bướm cần ăn nhiều như vậy trước khi hóa nhộng?
Why does a caterpillar need to eat so much? Say what happens and why.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain what would happen, and why.
questions.prompt: Why might cutting down a whole forest affect animals that don't even live directly in the trees?
hints: Say what happens, then explain the wider connection.
questions.worked_example: Say what happens first. Then add one because.

feedback.correct: A clear, advanced explanation connecting the specific effect to the wider ecosystem. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Say what might happen, then explain how different animals in a forest are connected to each other.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.primary: Explaining an advanced ecological concept aloud
life_skill.hidden_lesson: This is exactly why protecting forests matters so much for wildlife, not just the trees themselves.

analysis.primary_construct: verbalising both an effect and the underlying reason for it
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: A step beyond simple prediction - explaining the mechanism, not just the outcome.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Stating an effect correctly with no explanation of why shows the fact, not the mechanism, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just what, is where deeper science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why does that happen' after sharing any cause-and-effect fact.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Everything in an ecosystem is connected through the food chain, so removing trees affects far more than just the tree-dwellers.

es.instruction: Explica qué pasaría, y por qué.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué podría talar todo un bosque afectar a animales que ni siquiera viven directamente en los árboles?
hints: Di qué pasa, y luego explica la conexión más amplia.
es.worked_example: Di primero qué pasa. Luego añade un porqué.

feedback.correct: Una explicación clara y avanzada que conecta el efecto específico con el ecosistema completo. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Di qué podría pasar, y luego explica cómo están conectados entre sí los distintos animales de un bosque.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Todo en un ecosistema está conectado a través de la cadena alimentaria, así que quitar árboles afecta a mucho más que solo a quienes viven en ellos.

narration.text: Explica qué pasaría, y por qué.

fr.instruction: Explique ce qui se passerait, et pourquoi.
fr.prompt: Pourquoi couper toute une forêt pourrait-il affecter des animaux qui ne vivent même pas directement dans les arbres ?
hints: Dis ce qui se passe, puis explique le lien plus large.
fr.worked_example: Dis d'abord ce qui se passe. Puis ajoute un parce que.

feedback.correct: Une explication claire et avancée reliant l'effet précis à l'écosystème plus large. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Dis ce qui pourrait se passer, puis explique comment les différents animaux d'une forêt sont liés entre eux.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tout dans un écosystème est lié par la chaîne alimentaire, donc enlever les arbres affecte bien plus que les animaux qui y vivent.

narration.text: Explique ce qui se passerait, et pourquoi.

pt.instruction: Explique o que aconteceria, e por quê.

pt.worked_example: Diga primeiro o que acontece. Depois adicione um porque.

feedback.correct: Uma explicação clara e avançada, conectando o efeito específico ao ecossistema mais amplo. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Diga o que poderia acontecer, depois explique como diferentes animais de uma floresta estão conectados entre si.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tudo em um ecossistema está conectado pela cadeia alimentar, então remover árvores afeta muito mais do que só quem vive nelas.

narration.text: Explique o que aconteceria, e por quê. Por que derrubar uma floresta inteira pode afetar animais que nem vivem diretamente nas árvores?

it.instruction: Spiega cosa accadrebbe, e perché.
it.prompt: Perché il taglio di un'intera foresta potrebbe influenzare anche animali che non vivono direttamente sugli alberi?

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tutto in un ecosistema è collegato attraverso la catena alimentare, quindi togliere gli alberi influenza molto più di chi vive solo sugli alberi.

de.instruction: Erkläre, was passieren würde, und warum.
de.prompt: Warum könnte das Abholzen eines ganzen Waldes auch Tiere betreffen, die nicht einmal direkt in den Bäumen leben?

feedback.incorrect: Sag, was passieren könnte, dann erkläre, wie verschiedene Tiere in einem Wald miteinander verbunden sind.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Alles in einem Ökosystem ist durch die Nahrungskette miteinander verbunden, deshalb betrifft das Entfernen von Bäumen weit mehr als nur die Tiere, die in ihnen leben.

narration.text: Erkläre, was passieren würde, und warum.

nl.instruction: Leg uit wat er zou gebeuren, en waarom.
nl.prompt: Waarom zou het kappen van een heel bos dieren kunnen beïnvloeden die niet eens direct in de bomen leven?

nl.worked_example: Zeg eerst wat er gebeurt. Voeg dan één omdat toe.

feedback.correct: Een duidelijke, geavanceerde uitleg die het specifieke effect verbindt met het bredere ecosysteem. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Zeg wat er zou kunnen gebeuren, en leg dan uit hoe verschillende dieren in een bos met elkaar verbonden zijn.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Alles in een ecosysteem is verbonden via de voedselketen, dus het verwijderen van bomen beïnvloedt veel meer dan alleen de boombewoners.

ru.instruction: Объясни, что произойдёт, и почему.
ru.prompt: Почему вырубка целого леса может повлиять на животных, которые даже не живут прямо на деревьях?

feedback.incorrect: Скажи, что может произойти, затем объясни, как разные животные в лесу связаны друг с другом.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Всё в экосистеме связано через пищевую цепь, поэтому вырубка деревьев влияет гораздо больше, чем только на тех, кто живёт на деревьях.

narration.text: Объясни, что произойдёт, и почему. Почему вырубка целого леса может повлиять на животных, которые даже не живут прямо на деревьях?

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか、そしてその理由を説明しよう。

nl.instruction: Leg uit wat er zou gebeuren, en waarom.
nl.prompt: Waarom ontwerpen wetenschappers een test waarbij maar één ding tegelijk verandert?
hints: Zeg de regel, en leg dan uit wat er fout zou gaan zonder die regel.
nl.worked_example: Zeg eerst wat er gebeurt. Voeg dan één omdat toe.

feedback.correct: Een duidelijke, geavanceerde uitleg over eerlijk testen. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Zeg de regel over eerlijke tests, en leg dan uit wat er fout zou gaan als je die zou breken.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Door maar één ding te veranderen, kun je eerlijk precies zien wat een verschil in het resultaat veroorzaakte.

narration.text: Leg uit wat er zou gebeuren, en waarom. Waarom ontwerpen wetenschappers een test waarbij maar één ding tegelijk verandert?

ru.instruction: Объясни, что произойдёт, и почему.
ru.prompt: Почему учёные разрабатывают тест, в котором меняется только одно за раз?
hints: Скажи правило, затем объясни, что пошло бы не так без него.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи, что происходит. Потом добавь одно «потому что».

feedback.correct: Чёткое, продвинутое объяснение о честном тестировании. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Скажи правило о честных тестах, затем объясни, что пошло бы не так, если бы ты его нарушил.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Изменение только одного параметра позволяет честно увидеть, что именно вызвало разницу в результате.

narration.text: Объясни, что произойдёт, и почему. Почему учёные разрабатывают тест, в котором меняется только одно за раз?

tr.prompt: Bilim insanları neden bir kerede sadece bir şeyin değiştiği bir test tasarlar?
hints: Kuralı söyle, sonra o olmadan nelerin ters gidebileceğini açıkla.
tr.worked_example: Önce ne olacağını söyle. Sonra bir 'çünkü' ekle.

feedback.correct: Adil test hakkında açık, ileri düzey bir açıklama. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Adil testler hakkındaki kuralı söyle, sonra onu bozarsan nelerin ters gidebileceğini açıkla.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Sadece bir şeyi değiştirmek, sonuçtaki herhangi bir farkın tam olarak neye sebep olduğunu adil bir şekilde görmeni sağlar.

narration.text: Ne olacağını ve nedenini açıkla. Bilim insanları neden bir kerede sadece bir şeyin değiştiği bir test tasarlar?

zh.instruction: 解释会发生什么,以及为什么。
zh.prompt: 为什么科学家设计测试时只改变一个因素?
hints: 先说出这个规则,然后解释如果不这样做会出什么问题。
zh.worked_example: 先说出会发生什么,然后加上一个“因为”来说明原因。

feedback.correct: 一个清楚、进阶的解释,涉及公平测试。🔬
feedback.incorrect: 先说出公平测试的规则,然后解释如果违反了会出什么问题。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 只改变一个因素,才能公平地看清楚到底是什么导致了结果的差异。

narration.text: 解释会发生什么,以及为什么。为什么科学家设计测试时只改变一个因素?

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか、そしてその理由を説明しよう。
ja.prompt: なぜ科学者は、1回に1つのことだけを変えるテストを計画するの?
hints: ルールを言って、それがないとどうなってしまうのか説明しよう。
ja.worked_example: まず何が起こるかを言おう。それから、理由を1つ付け加えよう。

feedback.correct: 公平なテストについての、はっきりした高度な説明ができたね。🔬
feedback.incorrect: 公平なテストについてのルールを言って、それを守らないとどうなるか説明しよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 1つだけを変えることで、結果の違いが何によって起きたのかを、公平に正確に知ることができるから。

narration.text: 何が起こるか、そしてその理由を説明しよう。

ko.instruction: 무슨 일이 일어날지, 그리고 왜 그런지 설명해보세요.
ko.prompt: 과학자들은 왜 한 번에 딱 한 가지만 바꾸도록 시험을 설계할까요?
hints: 규칙을 말하고, 그것이 없으면 무엇이 잘못될지 설명해보세요.
ko.worked_example: 먼저 무슨 일이 일어나는지 말하세요. 그다음 이유를 하나 덧붙이세요.

feedback.correct: 공정한 시험에 대한 또렷하고 수준 높은 설명이에요. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: 공정한 시험의 규칙을 말하고, 그것을 어기면 무엇이 잘못될지 설명해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 한 가지만 바꾸면 결과의 차이를 일으킨 원인을 정확하고 공정하게 알 수 있기 때문이에요.

narration.text: 무슨 일이 일어날지, 그리고 왜 그런지 설명해보세요. 과학자들은 왜 한 번에 딱 한 가지만 바꾸도록 시험을 설계할까요?

id.instruction: Jelaskan apa yang akan terjadi, dan alasannya.
id.prompt: Mengapa para ilmuwan merancang uji coba di mana hanya satu hal yang berubah setiap kalinya?

id.worked_example: Ucapkan dulu apa yang terjadi. Lalu tambahkan satu alasan karena.

feedback.correct: Penjelasan yang jelas dan tingkat lanjut tentang uji yang adil. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Ucapkan aturan tentang uji yang adil, lalu jelaskan apa yang akan salah jika aturan itu dilanggar.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Mengubah hanya satu hal memungkinkanmu melihat secara adil apa yang benar-benar menyebabkan perbedaan pada hasilnya.

narration.text: Jelaskan apa yang akan terjadi, dan alasannya. Mengapa para ilmuwan merancang uji coba di mana hanya satu hal yang berubah setiap kalinya?

vi.instruction: Giải thích điều gì sẽ xảy ra, và vì sao.
vi.prompt: Vì sao các nhà khoa học thiết kế một thí nghiệm mà chỉ một yếu tố thay đổi mỗi lần?

feedback.incorrect: Nói ra quy tắc về thí nghiệm công bằng, rồi giải thích điều gì sẽ sai nếu bạn phá vỡ nó.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Chỉ thay đổi một yếu tố giúp bạn thấy chính xác và công bằng điều gì gây ra sự khác biệt trong kết quả.

narration.text: Giải thích điều gì sẽ xảy ra, và vì sao.

analysis.primary_construct: producing a genuine, answerable question about a science topic
